```{r}
#Attempting to assess how much dataset origin confounds my results
merged_df$dataset_group <- ifelse(substr(merged_df$patient_id, 1,1) =="G", "G", "P")
table(merged_df$dataset_group)
head(merged_df[, c("patient_id", "dataset_group")])

# Get all leiden abundance columns
leiden_cols <- colnames(merged_df)[grepl("abundance_metacluster_leiden", colnames(merged_df))]
cat("Number of metacluster abundance columns:", length(leiden_cols), "\n")

zero_mc <- sapply(merged_df_dfs[, leiden_cols], function(col) all(col == 0))
zero_mc_names <- names(zero_mc[zero_mc])
print(zero_mc_names)
leiden_cols <-setdiff(leiden_cols ,zero_mc_names)




```
```{r}
###just want to check survival between the two datasets
# Log-rank test
survdiff(Surv(dfs_months, dfs_event) ~ dataset_group, data = merged_df)
# Fit KM
km_fit <- survfit(Surv(dfs_months, dfs_event) ~ dataset_group, data = merged_df)

# Plot
ggsurvplot(
  km_fit,
  data = merged_df,
  pval = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  palette = c("#E7B800", "#2E9FDF"),
  legend.labs = c("G", "P"),
  xlab = "Time (months)",
  ylab = "DFS Probability",
  title = "Disease-Free Survival by Dataset Group (G vs P)"
)
```
```{r}
### two approches to invesitage surivial
# Cluster patients by their full probability profile
set.seed(42)
prob_mat <- as.matrix(merged_df[, leiden_cols])
km_profiles <- kmeans(prob_mat, centers = 2)


merged_df$profile_group <- factor(km_profiles$cluster)

# KM plot by profile
km_fit2 <- survfit(Surv(dfs_months, dfs_event) ~ profile_group, data = merged_df)
ggsurvplot(km_fit2, data = merged_df, pval = TRUE, risk.table = TRUE,
           title = "DFS by cluster probability profile group")



###now kind of need to know which clusters are responsible
# From your earlier kmeans result with k=2
km_profiles <- kmeans(prob_mat, centers = 2)

# Centroids: rows = profile groups, cols = leiden clusters

centroids <- as.data.frame(km_profiles$centers)
colnames(centroids) <- leiden_cols
centroids$profile_group <- paste0("Group", 1:2)

centroids <- as.data.frame(km_profiles$centers)
colnames(centroids) <- leiden_cols

top_n <- 10

for (g in 1:2) {
  cat("\n--- Profile Group", g, "---\n")
  row_vec <- as.numeric(centroids[g, ])       # convert row to numeric vector
  names(row_vec) <- leiden_cols               # re-attach names
  sorted <- sort(row_vec, decreasing = TRUE)  # now sort works fine
  print(head(sorted, top_n))
}



```
```{r}
cent_long <- centroids %>%
  mutate(profile_group = paste0("Group", 1:2)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = leiden_cols,
               names_to = "leiden_cluster",
               values_to = "mean_prob")

# Keep only clusters where at least one group has mean_prob > threshold
top_clusters <- cent_long %>%
  group_by(leiden_cluster) %>%
  summarise(max_prob = max(mean_prob)) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_prob)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  pull(leiden_cluster)

cent_long %>%
  filter(leiden_cluster %in% top_clusters) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = leiden_cluster, y = profile_group, fill = mean_prob)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(mean_prob, 2)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#2E9FDF") +
  labs(title = "Top clusters by profile group",
       x = "Cluster", y = "Profile Group", fill = "Mean Prob") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

diff_df <- data.frame(
  leiden_cluster = leiden_cols,
  group1_prob    = as.numeric(centroids[1, ]),
  group2_prob    = as.numeric(centroids[2, ])
)

diff_df$difference <- abs(diff_df$group1_prob - diff_df$group2_prob)

# Top discriminating clusters
diff_df %>%
  arrange(desc(difference)) %>%
  head(15)
```

```{r}
# All event / no-event MCs must be columns in merged_df
stopifnot(all(mc_event_both    %in% colnames(merged_df)))
stopifnot(all(mc_no_event_both %in% colnames(merged_df)))
merged_df_scores <- merged_df %>%
  mutate(
    # summed abundance over bad (event) metaclusters
    bad_abund  = rowSums(across(all_of(mc_event_both)),    na.rm = TRUE),
    # summed abundance over good (no-event) metaclusters
    good_abund = rowSums(across(all_of(mc_no_event_both)), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # raw score: higher = more bad vs good
    score_raw = bad_abund - good_abund
  )

ggplot(merged_df_scores, aes(x = score_raw)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, colour = "black", fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Raw prognosis score (bad - good MC abundance)",
    y = "Number of patients"
  )

```

```{r}
grep("adjuv", colnames(merged_df), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
table(merged_df$has_adjuvant_chemotherapy, useNA = "ifany")

merged_df_adjuvent <-merged_df %>%
  filter(has_adjuvant_chemotherapy =="yes")
leiden_cols <- colnames(merged_df)[grepl("abundance_metacluster_leiden", colnames(merged_df))]
cat("Number of metacluster abundance columns:", length(leiden_cols), "\n")
merged_df_dfs <- merged_df_adjuvent %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(dfs_months),
    dfs_months > 0,
    !is.na(dfs_event)
  )
length(merged_df_dfs$dfs_months)
```
```{r}
merged_df_dfs <- merged_df_dfs %>%
  mutate(
    dfs_group_adjuv = factor(
      dfs_event,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("No DFS event", "DFS event")
    )
  )

table(merged_df_dfs$dfs_group_adjuv, useNA = "ifany")
mc_prob_stats_adjuvent <- map_dfr(leiden_cols, function(col) {
  p <- merged_df_dfs[[col]]

  p_event   <- p[merged_df_dfs$dfs_group_adjuv == "DFS event"]
  p_noevent <- p[merged_df_dfs$dfs_group_adjuv == "No DFS event"]

  p_event   <- p_event[!is.na(p_event)]
  p_noevent <- p_noevent[!is.na(p_noevent)]

  if (length(p_event) == 0 || length(p_noevent) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      metacluster          = col,
      mean_prob_event      = NA_real_,
      mean_prob_noevent    = NA_real_,
      median_prob_event    = NA_real_,
      median_prob_noevent  = NA_real_,
      p_value              = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  wt <- wilcox.test(p_event, p_noevent, exact = FALSE)

  tibble(
    metacluster          = col,
    mean_prob_event      = mean(p_event),
    mean_prob_noevent    = mean(p_noevent),
    median_prob_event    = median(p_event),
    median_prob_noevent  = median(p_noevent),
    p_value              = wt$p.value
  )
})

mc_prob_stats_adjuvent <- mc_prob_stats_adjuvent %>%
  arrange(p_value)

mc_prob_stats_adjuvent

```
```{r}
mc_prob_stats_adjuvent_event_p_sorted <- mc_prob_stats_adjuvent %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_prob_event), p_value)

head(mc_prob_stats_adjuvent_event_p_sorted)



mc_prob_stats_adjuvent <- mc_prob_stats_adjuvent %>%
  mutate(
    diff_event_minus_noevent = mean_prob_event - mean_prob_noevent
  )
event_enriched_adjuvent <- mc_prob_stats_adjuvent %>%
  arrange(desc(diff_event_minus_noevent))

head(event_enriched_adjuvent, 10)
```
